The '''SD-4''' was the fourth model of the [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] [[SD-series battle droid/Legends|SD-series battle droids]].

==Characteristics==
The SD-4 model was an improvement over the first three versions in the [[SD-series battle droid/Legends|SD-series]], incorporating secret programming data that was stolen from the files of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]]'s [[Dark Trooper Project]].<ref name="EGTD" />
